description: A Dart class that manages patient data in a Flutter application, providing CRUD stubs, dependency binding, and data fetching from an API endpoint.

classes.name: PatientProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages patient list state and API interactions.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds external dependencies AuthProvider and ApiClient to the provider.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Updates the loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all patients from the backend API and updates the internal list; handles errors and loading state.

methods.name: _extractList
methods.description: Extracts a list of items from various possible response shapes.

methods.name: _humanizeError
methods.description: Converts error objects into user-friendly error messages.
